name: ai-smart-study-companion
description: An AI-powered full-stack web application that transforms your study materials into interactive learning experiences.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan" "cd server && bun run dev" "cd client && bun run dev"
scripts.install:all: bun install && cd server && bun install && cd ../client && bun install
scripts.build: bun install && cd server && bun install && cd ../client && bun install && bun run build
